title: Price Adjustments
description: Optional ordered adjustment table on a binding fixed-price option; fixed_price is the base rate. A table and a fully priced seller offer have equal standing: a table tells the buyer it can compute the price locally for the selections and dates it covers; without one the price applies only to what was quoted, and yield-managed sellers are not expected to publish one. Composition is one running total in declared order: each firing row adds (fee) or subtracts (discount) round(running x rate) or its amount, so a 10% fee then a 10% fee is x1.21. An index factor f is a fee rate f - 1 or a discount rate 1 - f. Selection rows fire once per dimension (first applicable row); always rows each fire; valid_from/valid_until bound a row at the purchase start_time. A table applies only to the account it was returned for and expires with its quote (proposal or offer expires_at, or the discovery response's validity). Any change to the table mints a new pricing_option_id, so the accepted pricing_option_id (covered by terms_digest) identifies exactly one immutable table: changes the agreement already permits are priced from that table, which both parties retain from discovery and the seller MUST price from, not from a later table. The table grants no change rights; those come only from change_terms[]. Sellers MUST NOT return a table to callers below adcp_version 3.3. See pricing-models.mdx#selection-dependent-price-adjustments.

verifier_constraints.composition: Rows apply sequentially to one running total in declared order; each step rounds half away from zero to price precision.
verifier_constraints.price_precision: Greatest of the currency minor-unit exponent, 4 for cpm/vcpm/cpc/cpcv/cpv/cpp, and the fewest decimals exactly representing fixed_price and each amount, by numeric value.
verifier_constraints.flight_windows: A flight crossing a row's valid_from or valid_until is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST.
verifier_constraints.resolved_price_binding: A buyer-supplied pricing that differs from the resolved result MUST be rejected with INVALID_REQUEST carrying resolved_fixed_price and resolved_price_breakdown.
